sample_unit: cases (internal cohort); external: 1020 TCGA-BRCA slides and 500 Camelyon17 slides
models_evaluated: Proposed TIL quantification framework (foundation-model embeddings, graph attention, YOLO + U-Net)

links.outcome: Performance across internal and external sites and scanners
links.effect: Internal 94.7% accuracy, AUC 0.92; external 92.1%/0.895 (TCGA-BRCA) and 91.3%/0.882 (Camelyon17), a modest drop at new sites.
links.quote: The framework achieved 94.7% accuracy and AUC = 0.92 internally, with robust external performance (92.1% / 0.895 and 91.3% / 0.882), demonstrating effective cross-scanner and cross-staining adaptability.

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI framework for TIL quantification using multi-reader validation, retrospective external validation, and a simulated deployment pilot measuring processing time reduction, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
